description: This file defines the Currency controller class for the OpenCart admin module, handling currency-related functionalities such as listing, editing, enabling/disabling, deleting, and refreshing currencies.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Controller class managing currency operations in the admin localisation module of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main currency list view with breadcrumbs and action links.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for listing currencies, including pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the currency form for adding or editing a currency.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a new or existing currency, including validation and permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected currencies after validation checks.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Adds a task to refresh currency data.
